newsitem.title: FINLAND: ENSO SEES '97 EARNINGS BETTER THAN '96.
newsitem.headline: ENSO SEES '97 EARNINGS BETTER THAN '96.

text.p: Finland's second largest forest industry group Enso Oy said on Wednesday it expected full-year 1997 profit to improve on 1996.
""Thanks to improved market prospects, Enso expects the financial results for 1997 to be somewhat better than for 1996," it said in a statement with its first-half results.

It had earlier said it expected earnings this year to be similar to that for 1996, when it posted a 1.7 billion markka profit after financial items. Its H1 profit dipped to 928 million markka from 1.12 billion in the year-ago period.
